label: IGH / FGFR3 and NSD2

sections.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus, with potent B-lineage regulatory elements.
FGFR3 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase.
NSD2 encodes a histone H3 lysine-36 methyltransferase.

The t(4;14) rearrangement places IGH regulatory elements near NSD2 and FGFR3, increasing NSD2-associated chromatin activity and, in many cases, FGFR3 signaling. Some tumors lose FGFR3 expression while retaining NSD2 deregulation.
